featureWeights.description: Governs the primary nocturnal concentration buildup vs midday maritime cleansing cycle.
Captures the steep evening rush-hour concentration accumulation gradient vs slower morning ventilation.
Shapes the twin daily vehicular traffic emission peaks across Western Express Highway and South Mumbai arteries.
Calibrates day-to-day persistent airmass baseline from verified morning CPCB/SAFAR CAAQMS observations.

physicalMechanisms.impact: Drops PM2.5 sharply by 35-50% between 12:00 and 16:00 IST as clean marine air displaces urban aerosols.

physicalMechanisms.phenomenon: Nocturnal Boundary Layer Collapse & Deonar Trapping
physicalMechanisms.impact: Shallow radiation inversion below 150m traps industrial and festival particulate smoke, reaching historic peaks of 794.77 µg/m³ during Diwali.

physicalMechanisms.phenomenon: Sanjay Gandhi National Park Biogenic Buffer
physicalMechanisms.impact: Forest canopy buffers regional background spikes, yielding 30-40% lower daytime particulate load than coastal traffic corridors.
Strong WNW onshore sea winds on Nov 10 flushed Diwali aerosol stagnation, restoring baseline PM2.5 to 45-60 µg/m³ within 18 hours.

scientificLimitations: Unforeseen point emissions (e.g., temporary construction dust or localized fires) cannot be anticipated without real-time satellite lidar.
Monsoon-to-winter transitional wind reversals cause occasional multi-hour phase shifts in sea-breeze penetration.
Nocturnal sensor auto-calibration zero-drifts between 23:00 and 02:00 IST can produce occasional false spikes in raw optical counters.
